photo_didentite.texteAccordeon:
For a Singapore passport, the photo size requirements are as follows:

/nPrinted Format:/n
  • Size: 35mm x 45mm (width x height).
  • The head size must be 32-36 mm which takes about 70-80% of the photo.
    • Digital Format:/n
  • Size: 400 x 514 pixels.
  • File Size: Between 60KB and 120KB.
  • Format: JPEG.
  • Resolution: At least 600 DPI.

photo_didentite.texteAccordeon:
In Singapore, you can get passport photos at various locations:

/n
  • Photo Studios: Many professional photo studios offer passport photo services, ensuring that the photos meet the official requirements.
  • Shopping Malls: There are photo booths and shops in many shopping malls that offer passport photo services.
  • Supermarkets & Department Stores: Some larger supermarkets and department stores, like NTUC FairPrice and Mustafa Centre, have photo booths where you can take passport photos.
  • Post Offices: Certain Singapore Post (SingPost) branches offer passport photo services.
  • Community Centres: Some community centres in Singapore have photo booths or studios that offer passport photo services.
  • Online Services: You can also use our online service Smartphone iD, which allow you to take your photo at home and have it processed to meet Singapore's passport requirements.

photo_didentite.texteAccordeon: It depends on the document type. Official documents that are used for biometrical machine reading (electronic passports, visas, identity cards) don’t allow fringe because it makes it harder to read the biometrical data from the scan. Then fringe must be sided to either side and pinned down with unnoticeable bobby pins. However, more casual identity documents like a student card, or transportation card can have a passport photo with a fringe.If you are not sure about the requirements, you can use Smartphone iD service that will get you a conform and checked photo for the document of your choice.

photo_didentite.texteAccordeon: Not all governments allow glasses because it’s very hard to get it right. Thick frames are forbidden, as well as tinted glass, no reflection can appear, and they must sit correctly. Therefore, those governments who don’t forbid wearing glasses, highly suggest taking them off for the photo.
photo_didentite.titre_accordeon: Can you wear glasses in a passport photo?

photo_didentite.texteAccordeon:
Yes, you can wear makeup in your passport photo. But note that make-up should be light.

/n
  • Don't put too much eyeshadow on your eyelids.
    • /n
  • Often glossy lipstick might create a reflection, therefore, better opt for a matte lipstick, if you want to accent your lips.
    • /n
  • It’s useful also to check that your skin is not oily before taking a photo, as it can create a light reflection, too.
    • /n
  • Finally, remember that the passport photo must be as natural as possible and must resemble you on a regular day.
photo_didentite.titre_accordeon: Can you wear makeup in a passport photo?

photo_didentite.texteAccordeon: Strong colors that stand out clearly from the background are suitable for a passport photo. Since a light background is required, darker colors are beneficial to increase contrast.Also, make sure your shirt doesn't show too much skin, as shirtless passport photos are prohibited.Finally, uniforms of any kind are also prohibited on a biometric passport photo.
